description: A stamped permit needs walking to Marrow Street and then over to Foundry Way, where it'll be ignored in person rather than by post. 14₵.
name: Permit Run

emotes: {who} presents a Ward Nine permit to nobody in particular on Marrow Street.
{who} waves the stamped flimsy at a shuttered frontage and calls it served.
{who} slaps the permit against a Foundry Way post and photographs it as proof of delivery.
{who} leaves the permit somewhere plausible on Foundry Way and considers the matter closed.
